integrity: The package contains a self-contained elementary proof and a separate finite exhaustive verification script. No independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The full polynomial covers all m,n>=2; the all-minimum classification is only asserted for m,n>=5. The scalar minimum size is previously established. A potentially relevant 2024 general paper on super-domination polynomials could be assessed only via its abstract and reported list of graph families; publication priority is not independently established. A finite checker supports but does not prove the parameter-uniform identity.
title: Complete super-domination polynomial and minimum-set rigidity of rectangular rook graphs
